column5: Campaign 22 propagates node or authority shutdown failure to a nonzero executable result and emits success only after every stage succeeds; complete Go startup modes, signals, tracing, diagnostics, and service integration remain open.
Campaign 22 publishes the bounded shutdown grace and consumes validated read-node configuration; the full Go configuration surface, reload, deprecation, and compatibility behavior remains open.

Campaign 22 stops admission, drains fixed workers, aggregates failures, and preserves structured shutdown order; complete Go listener, status, metrics, TLS, extensions, and protocol breadth remains open.

Campaign 22 gives accepted sockets RAII cleanup, cancellation, forced close, and join-before-authority shutdown; prepared statements, transactions, writes, cursor commands, and broad connection semantics remain open.
Campaign 22 separates cloneable session openers from the unique process authority; the complete Go driver/session interface remains open.
Campaign 22 opens worker-local read sessions under one process authority and drains them before shutdown; full TiDB session, transaction, statement, and privilege behavior remains open.
Campaign 22 retains exact accepted, active, completed, and failed connection lifecycle counters through drain; full per-user admission, limits, metrics, and dynamic configuration remain open.
Campaign 22 safely drains sockets at every handshake or worker failure boundary; complete Go capability, TLS, plugin, attribute, and compatibility handling remains open.
Campaign 22 retains bounded command framing through connection drain and failure; complete Go packet parsing, command variants, and malformed-input parity remains open.
